# service settings ----------------------------------

# Biletado API base URL (change to your tenant)
API_BASE_URL = 'https://your_tenant-api.smart-city-booking.de/api'
TENANT = 'your_tenant'

# credentials for the Buchungsplattform
APP_USERNAME=your_username
APP_PASSWORD=your_password

# Interval for fetching booking tasks (seconds)
FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 300
# Trigger client refresh every x seconds
CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS = 60

# reverse proxy settings (optional) ------------
FQDN=booking-service.example.com
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com=== .env ===

=== docker-compose.yml ===
version: "3.8"

services:
 display-server:
    # build image locally ...
    build: .
    image: display-server:latest
    # ... or pull it from docker container registry
    # image: registry.opencode.de/smart-city-ulm/co-learning-spaces/display-server:latest
    container_name: display-server
    restart: always
    networks:
      - shared-net
    # either load complete .env file 
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      # set basepath according reverse proxy path or keep it empty
      BASE_PATH: /display-server
    #  ... or import variables from environment   
    #   # settings for app
    #   API_BASE_URL: ${API_BASE_URL}
    #   TENANT: ${TENANT}
    #   APP_USERNAME: ${APP_USERNAME}
    #   APP_PASSWORD: ${APP_PASSWORD}
    #   FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS: ${FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS}
    #   CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS: ${CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS}
    #   # optional, to control FastAPI-Server-Host/Port
    #   # UVICORN_HOST: 0.0.0.0
    #   # UVICORN_PORT: 8001 
    #   # setting for reverse proxy
    #   VIRTUAL_HOST: ${FQDN}
    #   LETSENCRYPT_HOST: ${FQDN}
    #   LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_EMAIL}

    ports:
      # restrict to localhost when using reverse proxy
      - "127.0.0.1:8001:8001"
      # ... or open to all (e.g. for direct http access)
      # - "8001:8001" 


networks:
  shared-net:
    external: true

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat .env.example && echo "=== .env ===" && cat .env && echo "=== docker-compose.yml ===" && cat docker-compose.yml
